value.text: There were 144 passengers and six crew members on the plane when it flew into the mountains near Prads-Haute-Bléone.
The plane departed from Barcelona Tuesday morning and was headed towards Dusseldorf.

A Germanwings Airbus A320-200, registration D-AIPX performing flight 4U-9525
All 150 people on board were killed when the Airbus suddenly plummeted near Digne on a flight from Barcelona to Dusseldorf on Tuesday morning.
The aircraft was found at approximate position N44.2979 E6.4670, all on board perished.
